name: Deb Craft
residence: Big Horn County (official commissioners page lists a Basin mailing address)
occupation: Big Horn County commissioner and board chairman (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Big Horn County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election; listed as chairman on the official commissioners page; lost the August 2026 Republican primary)
background: Deb Craft is chairman of the Big Horn County Board of Commissioners, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The official commissioners page lists her as chairman. She won the November 2022 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported that she finished third in the August 2026 Republican primary with 1,144 votes. Incoming commissioner Jared Boardman takes office in January 2027.
